content.comment_body: Your email service may need a root certificate to verify the [product_name] (TLS) connection. You can get the required certificate directly from your email provider or from [url].

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience difficulties sending emails through the [product_name] communication module because of missing certificate authentication. Without the correct root certificate, email messages cannot be delivered successfully and are discarded. This indicates the need for manual certificate installation and reveals a lack of straightforward email sending setup for this product.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect hassle-free and dependable email functionality from the [product_name] module, without needing to manage certificates or perform manual installations.
